args.subject: Availability of child seats for car rentals
args.body:
Hello,

I am interested in renting a car from New Car Rental in London, and I would like to know whether you offer child seats with your rentals.

If child seats are available, could you please let me know whether they can be added to a reservation and whether there is any additional cost?

Thank you very much for your help.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
